author: Yffe
content: Fixed in d7344ae. Root cause: encode_combinator_call routed EVERY combinator arg through encode_slice_arg, appending the slice @-view to bare Paths, so forall_below/forall_from's int index arg n became n@ (a Verus type error: no view on int), a silent wrong encoding (contract-tv.md REQ-1). Fix (single file thermite-tv/src/ref_encode.rs): encode_combinator_call now consults the matched CombinatorSig.arg_kinds and dispatches the i-th arg via encode_combinator_arg per kind: Slice to @-view, Index to scalar (n as int, no @), Pred to closure, Value as-is. Covers all 8 frozen combinators by kind. Verified against real verus: forall_below/forall_from faithful obligations COMPILE and verify (1 verified, 0 errors); infidel gives counterexample (0 verified, 1 errors). Un-ignored pin ref_encode_index_arg_not_slice_viewed PASSES; teeth F1-F4 green. Gauntlet: cargo test --workspace 318 passed 0 failed; clippy -D warnings PASS; fmt --check PASS.
